A renovation is more than stripping out and building back up. The work stalls where one trade hands over to the next. The tiler waits for the plasterer, work on the bathroom stops because the pipework is not in yet. We take on the structural work and the finishing together, with the same team.
You tell us what you want, we tell you what is technically possible and what it will cost. The site visit and the quote cost you nothing.
The price is on paper before the work starts, itemised. Anything extra that comes up during the works, we discuss with you first.
Plastering, tiling, bathroom fittings and the skirting boards are part of the same job. The same people who strip it out also do the finishing.
